headline: Trump must divulge financial details about businesses in $10bn BBC lawsuit
context: US judge’s ruling could open up window into first family’s multiple ventures, in drawback of defamation suit on media Donald Trump must divulge detailed financial information from his many businesses as part of his $10bn defamation lawsuit against the British Broadcasting Corpora

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: US judge’s ruling could open up window into first family’s multiple ventures, in drawback of defamation suit on media Donald Trump must divulge detailed financial information from his many businesses as part of his $10bn defamation lawsuit against the British Broadcasting Corporation, a federal judge ruled during a discovery hearing on Tuesday, according to news reports. The ruling by US magistrate judge Enjoliqué Lett could open a unique window into the hundreds of businesses owned by the US president’s family trust. It also highlights a potential drawback for Trump’s strategy of bludgeoning critical media with multibillion-dollar lawsuits. Continue reading...
